scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('public/hot')) fs.unlinkSync('public/hot');" && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('public/hot')) fs.unlinkSync('public/hot'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('public/build', 'dist/build', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('public/images', 'dist/images', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('public/favicon.ico')) fs.copyFileSync('public/favicon.ico', 'dist/favicon.ico'); if(fs.existsSync('public/robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('public/robots.txt', 'dist/robots.txt');"
